name: Ricardo Welkin
japaneseName: リカード・ウェルキン
description: Ricardo Welkin is the boisterous captain of the mercenary band Iron Fang and a core protector of the Anastasia Camp. A veteran wolf demi-human warrior who acts as an adoptive father to the Pearlbaton triplets, he spearheaded frontline operations during the White Whale subjugation in Arc 3 and the defense of Priestella in Arc 5.
